Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The MS analysis described in this study is a small-molecule/metabolite profiling of the Buxue Tongluo Pills (BTP) components using UPLC-MS/MS, rather than a proteomics assay of proteins or peptides. While the PRIDE metadata lists 'All-ion fragmentation', the methods describe a full-scan analysis (m/z 100-1,500) for qualitative identification of 34 bioactive compounds. The Western Blot and Immunofluorescence mentioned are separate protein-level validations and not mass spectrometry proteomics runs. Consequently, no proteomics-specific workflow routing (base or modifier) is applicable.

scope: The powder of BTP (10 g) was ultrasonically dissolved with 300 ml, 75% ethanol, followed by concentrating to 100 ml using a rotary evaporator. Then, the supernatant was filtered by microporous membranes with a pore size of 0.22 μm. Then, the obtained 10 μl filtrates of BTP were analyzed by UPLC-MS/MS.
